verdict.rationale: Riveter's own AI enrichment takes the user's rows and fills new columns using AI. That includes ICP qualifiers and personalized outbound sentences, which gives per-row AI-generated output from the user's data. There is no evidence of dataset-level insights, analytics or proactive suggestions. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights or summaries across the whole dataset, proactive recommendations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: An enrichment takes rows of input data and fills in new columns using AI, web searches, web scrapes, and other tools.
enrich with qualifiers for your ICP, contact data, and even personalize sentences for outbound
A search_agent call asks one question and gets one AI-researched answer back
